annotations.title: List the latest issues of each site

description: Lists the issues of the newest run report of each site of every team the caller is a member of, each with its day, host, site ID, run ID, finding ID, section, title, and label. A site whose newest report has no finding adds no issue. `team` names one team by slug and answers 403 when the caller is not a member of it.

team.description: Slug of one team the caller is a member of
